avoid_supplements.name: Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sevelamer's polymer structure binds and reduces absorption of fat-soluble vitamins, increasing deficiency risk when supplemented without monitoring
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor vitamin levels regularly; separate dosing by at least 4 hours; consider water-soluble forms if deficiency develops

avoid_supplements.name: Phosphate-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct antagonism; phosphate supplements counteract therapeutic effect of sevelamer in hyperphosphatemia management
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; discontinue any phosphate-containing products

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sevelamer binds iron in the GI tract, significantly reducing bioavailability and potentially worsening anemia
avoid_supplements.action: Separate iron supplementation by 4+ hours from sevelamer; monitor hemoglobin/ferritin; consider IV iron if oral absorption inadequate

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minimal direct binding, but combined use requires monitoring to prevent hypercalcemia in renal disease patients
caution_supplements.action: Use only as directed by nephrologist; monitor serum calcium levels; adjust sevelamer dosing if needed

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential for additive GI effects and altered absorption; minimal direct interaction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for constipation or diarrhea; separate dosing by 2+ hours if possible

avoid_foods.name: High-phosphate foods (processed meats, dairy, nuts, seeds)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Dietary phosphate works against sevelamer's therapeutic goal of controlling serum phosphate; inadequate dietary control reduces drug efficacy
avoid_foods.action: Maintain strict low-phosphate renal diet; coordinate with dietitian; sevelamer dosing ineffective without dietary adherence

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair sevelamer GI distribution and can affect absorption of any co-administered fat-soluble nutrients
caution_foods.action: Take sevelamer with meals as directed; avoid very high-fat meals within 2 hours of dosing

caution_foods.name: Iron-rich foods (red meat, fortified cereals, leafy greens)
caution_foods.mechanism: Sevelamer may bind iron; excessive intake could theoretically worsen absorption when combined with supplementation
caution_foods.action: Include in diet as tolerated for nutrition; monitor iron levels; coordinate with iron supplementation timing

monitoring_notes: Sevelamer is a non-absorbed polymer; monitor serum phosphate, calcium, fat-soluble vitamin levels (especially vitamins A, D, K), and hemoglobin/iron status at baseline and regularly during therapy. Emphasize dietary phosphate restriction as essential to therapeutic success, and ensure 4+ hour separation between sevelamer and fat-soluble vitamin or iron supplementation.
